name: Frozen V3 natural-agent transfer validation
selection_rule: all eight fresh rescue tasks from the completed exhaustive historical controlled scan
primary_question: On the real OFF coding-agent trajectory, does the agent independently retrieve historical-fix-adjacent evidence in a shell search for which baseline relevance does not retain the record but frozen V3 counterfactual relevance on the exact same search target and prior trajectory would retain it?

primary_positive_definition.natural_retrieval: the OFF agent independently generated the repository search whose raw result contains a historical-fix-adjacent production record
primary_positive_definition.baseline: that record is not in the baseline high-relevance KEEP partition
primary_positive_definition.v3_counterfactual: using the exact same raw search target and exact prior OFF trajectory state, frozen V3 places the same record in the high-relevance KEEP partition

interpretation_limits: tasks were selected after the controlled exhaustive scan and therefore this is not prospective
a counterfactual search-level rescue does not by itself prove that downstream agent success was caused by the rescued record
all eight selected tasks must be reported regardless of outcome
